GHA.note: Responsible AI governance is mentioned only as a programme aim, no rule or authority.
The AI use named is inside the health sector, so it belongs to aisectoral.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health and Ghana Health Service, supported by WHO and UNDP, run a programme on AI, Digital Health and Human Security whose key focus is AI-enabled disease surveillance joining routine health data with climate data to predict malaria, cholera and meningitis.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health and Ghana Health Service

GHA.note: No AI model, dataset or computing built or hosted in the country is stated.
